items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: So, I got Leonard interested in going to television school

ctx.x: So, I got Leonard interested in going to television school and he was working with Errol Garner at the time and it's near graduation with him, so, I said, well, I'll take your job until you finish. But meanwhile, we recorded 'Misty' and recorded, and did all the rest of these things.
In the whole evolution of bass playing, who do you see as the important, you know, players who really, you know, changed the bass and opened it up?
